decisions.reason: No additional event is needed because the existing message-146 MODIFY already updates the eligible population to active prize-ticket holders, including secondary buyers who receive active tickets with the NFT.
The existing message-146 MODIFY already records that active Small Block tickets transfer with the NFT; the eligibility-window and post-draw expiration rules remain unchanged.
The source Event changes Small Block winner eligibility, while the candidate's existing message-146 MODIFY already records the independently stated transfer of active Big Block tickets.
Changing Small Block winner eligibility does not alter the Big Block prize amount, winner count, sales trigger, qualifying sale types, or pool-funding rules.
The existing message-146 FAQ MODIFY already records active-ticket transfer to secondary buyers and explains ticket entry, weighting, and expiration; no additional content change is required.
Small Block winner eligibility does not change the primary mint price, commission allocation, founder allocation, or prize-pool funding allocation.
Expanding winner eligibility to current active-ticket holders does not alter the winner-initiated claim method, one-click interaction, or Winners page announcement.
The existing message-146 MODIFY already records that active prize tickets transfer to the secondary buyer, fully representing the required ownership-transfer effect.
Small Block prize eligibility does not change the referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, timing, limit, or automatic payout mode.
The eligibility change does not require altering the Small Block ticket counter, Big Block ticket counter, permanent badges, or referral-code metadata attributes.
Winner eligibility based on active ticket ownership does not change wallet provisioning or wallet requirements, and the message-146 wallet requirement for holding prize tickets is already recorded.
The Small Block eligibility change does not alter royalty enablement, amount, structure, visibility, proceeds use, or funding persistence.
